question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the driven Kerr resonator of a Josephson bifurcation amplifier carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Siddiqi et al., PRL 93, 207002 (2004); Vijay, Devoret & Siddiqi, RSI 80, 111101 (2009)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: driven Kerr resonator of a Josephson bifurcation amplifier

carrier.name: quadratures x, y of the resonator amplitude

closure: loss kappa = 1 into a zero-temperature bath; the vacuum noise of the loss enters as D = kappa/8 per quadrature (truncated Wigner)
observable: photon number of the resonator (low or high branch); the qubit's dispersive shift chi changes the detuning
assumptions: single mode, rotating frame of the drive
H = -(Delta + chi) a†a + (U/2) a†²a² + F (a + a†)
